**1 — Scene:** Two overlapping pieces of cheese-and-tomato pizza, with a small mixed-leaf salad and one black olive.

**2 — Vessel:** A large square dinner plate, partly cropped. I estimate roughly 27 cm across; using a circular-equivalent diameter of about 28 cm gives an area of **3.14 × 14² ≈ 615 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Pizza, including its crust, tomato sauce and melted cheese; mixed salad leaves; one black olive. No separate oil or dressing is clearly visible.

Coverage totals **45.6%**, consistent with food occupying approximately half the plate.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **265 g and 618 kcal** is plausible for the visible pizza pieces and small salad. Most of the weight and energy comes from the pizza; plate size and pizza thickness are the main uncertainties.
